-- Calculate SBCR for shipments with excursions and temperature sensitivity (Medium or High)
SELECT 
  s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' as risk_note,
  e.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_duration_min' as ted_min,
  CASE 
    WHEN s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' = 'High' THEN 120  -- 2 hours in minutes
    WHEN s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' = 'Medium' THEN 480  -- 8 hours in minutes
    WHEN s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' = 'Low' THEN 1440  -- 24 hours in minutes
  END as sb_total_min,
  ROUND(CAST((e.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_duration_min')::numeric / 
    NULLIF(CASE 
      WHEN s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' = 'High' THEN 120
      WHEN s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' = 'Medium' THEN 480
      WHEN s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' = 'Low' THEN 1440
    END, 0) * 100 AS numeric), 2) as sbcr_pct
FROM shipments s
JOIN environmentalmonitoring e ON s.reckey = e.reckeylink
WHERE e.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count' != '0'
LIMIT 10;

-- Calculate average SBCR for temperature-sensitive shipments (High or Medium) with excursions
SELECT 
  ROUND(CAST(AVG(
    (e.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_duration_min')::numeric / 
    NULLIF(CASE 
      WHEN s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' = 'High' THEN 120
      WHEN s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' = 'Medium' THEN 480
      ELSE 1440
    END, 0) * 100 AS numeric), 2) as avg_sbcr_pct
FROM shipments s
JOIN environmentalmonitoring e ON s.reckey = e.reckeylink
WHERE e.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count' != '0'
  AND s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' IN ('High', 'Medium');

-- Average SBCR for all shipments with excursions (including Low)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(
    CAST(e.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_duration_min' AS numeric) / 
    NULLIF(CASE 
      WHEN s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' = 'High' THEN 120.0
      WHEN s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' = 'Medium' THEN 480.0
      WHEN s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' = 'Low' THEN 1440.0
      ELSE NULL
    END, 0) * 100
  ), 2) as avg_sbcr_all
FROM shipments s
JOIN environmentalmonitoring e ON s.reckey = e.reckeylink
WHERE e.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count' != '0'
  AND s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' IS NOT NULL;

-- Check if excursion_duration_min is the TED or if there's a separate field
SELECT env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_duration_min' as temp_exc_dur,
       env_metrics->>'excursion_duration_min' as root_exc_dur,
       env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count' as temp_exc_count
FROM environmentalmonitoring 
WHERE env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count' != '0'
LIMIT 5;

-- Final query: Average SBCR for temperature-sensitive shipments (High/Medium) with excursions
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(
    CAST(e.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_duration_min' AS numeric) / 
    NULLIF(CASE 
      WHEN s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' = 'High' THEN 120.0
      WHEN s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' = 'Medium' THEN 480.0
      ELSE NULL
    END, 0) * 100
  ), 2) as avg_stability_budget_consumption_pct
FROM shipments s
JOIN environmentalmonitoring e ON s.reckey = e.reckeylink
WHERE e.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count' != '0'
  AND s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' IN ('High', 'Medium');

-- Count of temperature-sensitive shipments with excursions
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM shipments s
JOIN environmentalmonitoring e ON s.reckey = e.reckeylink
WHERE e.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count' != '0'
  AND s.shipment_overview->'route'->>'risk_note' IN ('High', 'Medium');
